parsed.modern: on pieces of mother of pearl as they are imported from China, China, and with precisely the same refute. They appeared to be composed of the same gelatinous matter such as carbonate of lime. In all the shells of this description which were immersed in acids, the membranaceous parts retained the exact figure of the shell, and they appeared distinctly to be composed of fibres, arranged in a parallel direction, corresponding to the configuration of the shell.
